# How to get AFK Arcane Cultist:
Step 1) Go on your Arcane Cultist and turn on Arcanist Form.
Step 2) Kill things for a while. The faster your kills, the quicker you'll get it done, but go do murder.
Step 3) After collecting 1000 fragments, hold click on them. Boom! You've unlocked afk tachyons!
Step 4+) When you afk on your AC, you'll receive 1 Arcane Rock for every hour your afk session is. Afk for 2h40m? That's 2 Arcane Rocks.

Notes:
- If you have 2 AC's, you only need to do this once.
- To get Arcane Rocks, you must be afk'ing combat. It doesn't matter whether you're in Arcanist Form or not. And no, no candy.
- When using Arcane Rocks, they are based off your current AFK Info display. Kill some mobs for a bit first, then consume the item just as you would a candy.
